policy: Evidence labels are descriptive. Unknown is not compatible-by-default.

evidence_labels.physical_validated: Executed on named real hardware/image against the RC physical checklist.
evidence_labels.ci_validated: Automated/off-Pi behavior validated; no physical compatibility claim.
evidence_labels.community_reported: Reported by users but not reproduced by maintainers.

rows.notes: Validates Doctor engine, pack loader, policy, Patient Chart, Condition Packs, release assembly and guarded actions through the fake Pwnagotchi harness. Does not establish physical radio/display/service compatibility.
